description.value: Stitched onto a leather face, painted, or lacquered on, you have created an image on the face of your shield that evokes an ancient fear from a specific group. Choose a type of creature that isn't typically mindless such as aberration, animal, astral, dragon, elemental, ethereal, fey, fiend, giant, humanoid, or monitor. You etch an image of an ancient foe for that type of creature on the face of your shield, and can brandish it to make yourself more intimidating. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all Intimidation checks made against creatures of the chosen type while you're wielding this shield. You may choose undead as your type, but consider that many undead are mindless and immune to all mental effects, including Intimidation.

Activate f envision; Trigger An enemy targets you with an attack.

This bottle emits a buzzing sound that can only be heard if you hold it up to your ear. When you activate the bottle, a swarm of insects is released into the attacker's face. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until the end of their turn and must attempt a flat check as normal to determine if the attack misses due to the target being hidden.

The target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute.

Activate f envision; Trigger You use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction.

This tiny fleck of adamantine can impart some of its incredible hardness to the shield it is attached to. When activated, it grants the attached shield a +2 item bonus to Hardness for 1 minute.

Activate f command

This waxed pouch contains thick tree sap. When activated, the face of your shield becomes incredibly sticky. For 1 round the shield gains the grapple trait.

Activate 1 command

A small piece of a brick with surrounding mortar that is wrapped in gold wire. When activated, you create a brick wall 3 feet tall, 1 foot thick, and 15 feet wide. The wall must be adjacent to you and centered on your square.

The wall is difficult terrain for creatures moving through it, and it provides standard cover to anyone in its area or adjacent to it. It can potentially provide cover for creatures further away at the GM's discretion.

Perception +19; precise vision 60 feet, imprecise hearing 30 feet

Communication speech, telepathy with its wielder (Sylvan (living) or Necril (undead) and two other languages chosen when the rune is created)

Skills varies, see abilities; Int +5; Wis +3; Cha +2; Will +22

Knowledgeable The creator chooses three skills with Recall Knowledge actions, and two Lore skills. The rune is a master of those skills with a +26 bonus to checks with them. It is trained in other Recall Knowledge checks, with a +22 bonus.

Independent At the start of each of your turns, a shield etched with a knowledgeable true living/undead rune gains 1 action. It can use Share Knowledge, or prepare to Aid you with a Recall Knowledge check. If it prepares to Aid you, it gains a reaction usable only for that Aid.

Share Knowledge The shield attempts Recall Knowledge about an observed target. On a success or critical success it can immediately share the information. If the target is a creature and the shield identifies it, the shield points out a weak point; the first time you and each companion deal damage to that creature, you each deal an additional 1d6 precision damage.

Perception +19; precise vision 60 feet, imprecise hearing 30 feet

Communication speech, telepathy with its wielder (Sylvan (living) or Necril (undead) and two other languages chosen when the rune is created)

Skills varies, see abilities; Int +2; Wis +3; Cha +5; Will +22

Charismatic The creator chooses Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance. The rune is a master of the chosen skill with a +26 bonus to checks with it, and trained in the other listed skills with a +22 bonus. It gains the corresponding ability: Create a Diversion and Feint (Deception), Bon Mot (Diplomacy), Demoralize (Intimidation), or Fascinate (Performance).

Independent At the start of each of your turns, a shield etched with a charismatic true living/undead rune gains 1 action. It can perform one of its skill-based actions, or prepare to Aid you with the chosen skill. If it prepares to Aid you, it gains a reaction usable only for that Aid.

Bon Mot 1 The shield attempts a Diplomacy check to Bon Mot a creature as the skill feat. You suffer the penalty of a critical failure instead of the shield. If the target is affected, they may retort against you or the shield to remove the effect.

Create a Diversion 1 The shield attempts a Deception check to Create a Diversion. On a success you become hidden to the target, which gains no circumstance bonus against later Create a Diversion attempts by the shield.

Demoralize 1 The shield attempts an Intimidation check to Demoralize a creature. It takes no penalty for not sharing a language.

Fascinate 1 The shield attempts a Performance check against the Will DC of a creature that can observe it. On a success or critical success, the target is fascinated as by the fascinated condition.

Feint 1 The shield attempts a Deception check to Feint. On a success or critical success, the target is off-guard to you.

Activate f envision; Trigger You use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction.

This tiny fleck of adamantine can impart some of its incredible hardness to the shield it is attached to. When activated, it grants the attached shield a +6 item bonus to Hardness for 1 minute.

Activate f command; Trigger You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} to reduce the damage from an attack made with a metal weapon.

This token seems to shift position around the shield periodically and unpredictably. When activated you cause your shield to become magnetic. You may immediately attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} the blocked weapon and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to this check.

Activate f envision; Trigger You use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction.

This tiny fleck of adamantine can impart some of its incredible hardness to the shield it is attached to. When activated, it grants the attached shield a +10 item bonus to Hardness for 1 minute.

You have used special alchemical agents to polish the interior of your shield to a reflective shine, giving you a partial view of what is happening behind you.

You gain access to the following action, which can only be used one time. After you have used the action you must spend 1 minute cleaning the interior of your shield to be able to use it again. If someone uses the Repair action on your shield they can clean the shield during the repair.

Activate f envision; Frequency see description; Trigger An enemy attacks you and you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} condition because they are flanking you or you are unaware of them. Effect You do not suffer the penalty of the off-guard condition until the end of the current turn.

A simple hand mirror that can be tied to a shield. You gain access to the following reaction, which causes the mirror to fall off of the shield when used. You may reattach the mirror to the shield as part of a Repair action, or by adding it to the shield again as normal. If you use the Shield Block reaction, or gain the benefits of the Shield Block reaction with this shield in response to a critical hit from an attack, this adjustment is destroyed and cannot be repaired.

Activate r envision; Frequency see description Trigger You would be required to make a saving throw against an effect with the visual trait, but have not rolled yet. Effect You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your saving throw against the triggering effect, and the mirror adjustment falls off of the shield.

The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of their turn and must attempt a flat check as normal to determine if the attack misses due to concealment.

Activate 1 command

This small dense stone is wrapped in wire. When activated, it spreads across the face of your shield and up the arm that wields it, protecting it and its wearer for as long as the stone holds up aginst attack. Your shield gains 5d6 + 10 temporary Hit Points and you gain half that amount.

Activate f envision; Trigger An enemy targets you with an attack.

This bottle emits a buzzing sound that can only be heard if you hold it up to your ear. When you activate the bottle, a swarm of insects is released into the attacker's face. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of their turn and must attempt a flat check as normal to determine if the attack misses due to concealment.

The creature must also pass a DC 25 Fortitude save or be dazzled for 1 minute.

Activate f envision; Trigger You are targeted by, or in the area of an effect that deals acid, cold, electricity, fire, poison, or sonic damage.

A small crystal that refracts light into its constituent colors, wrapped in a leather cord that can be tied to your shield. When activated, for 1 minute your shield transforms into an elemental version of the triggering damage type. During this effect, you may use your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction when you would take damage from the triggering damage type in addition to physical damage, and your shield is immune to the triggering damage type.

You have added barbs around the edge of your shield's face that are particularly effective when used against creatures in very tight quarters. When you use the @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} action against a creature to remove the @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, or @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} condition and you do not roll a critical failure on the check, you also deal [[/r 2d6]] slashing damage to the creature.

Stitched onto a leather face, painted, or lacquered on, a coat of arms can mean a great deal depending on whom you're addressing. It can lend weight to your words, the deals you make, and even the insults you throw. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks while you are wielding the shield, as long as the coat of arms represents a faction that would be feared or respected by the target of the check, at the GM's discretion.

Activate f envision; Trigger You use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction.

This tiny fleck of adamantine can impart some of its incredible hardness to the shield it is attached to. When activated, it grants the attached shield a +14 item bonus to Hardness for 1 minute.

Usage applied to a light or medium shield

You have attached a leather or chain strap to your shield that you can loop over your forearm or a shoulder. When you @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.wQYmDStjdjn0I26t]{Release} your shield it doesn't fall to the ground and is considered to be worn. You may draw it as normal after Releasing it. The strap has a quick release, allowing you to still use actions and reactions that require throwing your shield, such as Interrupting Shield, but reattaching the strap is a three-action activity with the manipulate trait.

Activate f envision; Trigger An enemy targets you with an attack.

This bottle emits a buzzing sound that can only be heard if you hold it up to your ear. When you activate the bottle, a swarm of insects is released into the attacker's face. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for the triggering attack and must attempt a flat check as normal to determine if the attack misses due to concealment.

Usage applied to a medium or heavy shield

Your shield has been modified so that you can harness it firmly to your back when you are not actively wielding it. When you are wearing your shield instead of wielding it, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against attacks made against you if you are considered off-guard against the attack because you are flanked by another enemy. If you are hit by such an attack, you take the damage as normal. The shield also takes the damage but reduces it by its Hardness. If the shield is broken or destroyed, you no longer receive this benefit.

Activate f command

This waxed pouch contains thick tree sap. When activated, the face of your shield becomes incredibly sticky. For 1 minute the shield gains the grapple trait.

You have added a bracket or sheath to your shield that allows you to stow your weapon. A weapon sheath can contain a single one-handed weapon whose bulk cannot exceed the bulk of the shield. When you draw your shield, if you have a free hand and there is a weapon in the shield's weapon sheath, you may draw that weapon with the same interact action you use to draw the shield. Stowing a weapon in the sheath requires a single Interact action.

This adjustment cannot be applied to a shield with the accessible trait.

A mirror that is custom-fitted for your shield. You gain access to the following reaction. If you use the Shield Block reaction, or gain the benefits of the Shield Block reaction with this shield in response to a critical hit from an attack, this adjustment is broken and you cannot benefit from it until it has been repaired as part of a successful Repair action on the shield.

Activate r envision; Frequency once per minute; Trigger You are targeted by an effect with the visual trait; Effect You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC or saving throw against the triggering effect. Regardless of whether you are affected by the triggering effect, you may attempt to redirect the effect at a target within 30 feet. If the effect requires a saving throw, the target must attempt the same saving throw. If it requires an attack roll, attempt a shield attack roll to determine whether it hits.
